'''Bolgm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the period of the [[Galactic War]]. Together with [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Zeke]], Bolgm worked a scam where he would grab individuals with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] and notify Doctor Zeke who would remove them and then sell the cybernetics on the black market. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|defeat]] of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], Bolgm was in the [[Dealer's Den]] cantina when he noticed a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] accusing a man with cybernetics of cheating at [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]]. Bolgm grabbed the individual and took him to the back room, notifying Doctor Zeke to come meet them. The man, however, turned out to be [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Theron Shan]] who was working an undercover sting with the Twi'lek, [[Lylos Tannon]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. Tannon had been tracking Doctor Zeke and Bolgm for several weeks and had enlisted Shan and SIS Agent [[Jonas Balkar]] to help her. When Doctor Zeke arrived, Tannon distracted Bolgm who was then tackled by Shan. Bolgm scuffled with Shan before Tannon knocked the Houk unconscious with the butt of her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and secured him.<ref name="One Night at the Dealer's Den" />
